dsh-markdown-preview 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。产物文件聊天内预览：点击产物 chip 直接在对话中渲染 Markdown（宿主侧 markdown-it + highlight.js 代码高亮）、图片或纯文本，系统应用打开与在文件夹中显示仍一键可达。

posts.en:
dsh-markdown-preview is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. In-chat preview for produced files: click a produced-file chip to render Markdown (server-side markdown-it + highlight.js), images, or plain text right in the conversation; system-app open and reveal-in-folder stay one click away.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-6995cffc42b4d63f9ff0.html
